message.isekai_mahou.mount_tamed: %s is now your companion! Put a saddle on it to ride.
message.isekai_mahou.mount_saddled: %s is saddled. Use an empty hand to ride.
message.isekai_mahou.mount_not_owner: This mount belongs to someone else.
message.isekai_mahou.griffin_angry: The Griffin is too angry to take food.
message.isekai_mahou.pegasus_distrust: The Pegasus doesn't trust you. Offer it a Golden Apple.
message.isekai_mahou.pegasus_trust: The Pegasus accepts the gift. Trust: %s%%
message.isekai_mahou.wyvern_calmed: The Wyvern devours the rotten flesh and calms down... offer it a Shadow Essence.
message.isekai_mahou.wyvern_needs_calm: The Wyvern is too agitated. Calm it with rotten flesh first.
message.isekai_mahou.wyvern_distrust: The Wyvern absorbs the essence, but still distrusts you.
message.isekai_mahou.whistle_none: None of your mounts heard the whistle.
item.isekai_mahou.land_drake_reins.desc: A tame, sturdy runner: the "horse" of the kingdoms. Sold at the Guild shop.
item.isekai_mahou.nightmare_reins.desc: A steed with a burning mane, immune to fire. Only bosses drop these.
item.isekai_mahou.aurora_stag_reins.desc: A mountain stag that leaps high and never takes fall damage. The Kingdom's gift to the Honored.
item.isekai_mahou.mount_reins.use: Use to call the mount, already tamed and saddled. If it falls in battle, the Reins come back.
message.isekai_mahou.mount_reins_used: %s has arrived! Use an empty hand to ride.
message.isekai_mahou.mount_reins_back: %s fell in battle. The Reins came back to you.
message.isekai_mahou.mount_gift_stag: The Kingdom honors you with a gift: %s!
message.isekai_mahou.mount_drop_nightmar: From the boss's ashes comes a rare prize: %s!
hint.isekai_mahou.mounts.city: Want a mount? The Guild shop sells Reins. See "Mounts and Vehicles" in the Journal (%s).
hint.isekai_mahou.mounts.reins: Use the Reins to call the mount; then click it with an empty hand.
hint.isekai_mahou.mounts.tame.griffin: Offer raw fish or raw meat to tame it; then put a Saddle on it.
hint.isekai_mahou.mounts.tame.sky_ray: Offer an Essence (Wind works best) to tame it; then put a Saddle on it.
hint.isekai_mahou.mounts.tame.pegasus: Feed it Golden Apples until it trusts you, then mount it and add a Saddle.
hint.isekai_mahou.mounts.tame.wyvern: Calm it with rotten flesh, then offer a Shadow Essence; then put a Saddle on it.
hint.isekai_mahou.mounts.tame.land_drake: Offer meat to tame it; then put a Saddle on it.
hint.isekai_mahou.mounts.tame.nightmare: The Nightmare cannot be tamed: its Reins drop from bosses.
hint.isekai_mahou.mounts.tame.aurora_sta: The Aurora Stag cannot be tamed: it is the Kingdom's gift to the Honored.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.land_drake.desc: The "horse" of the kingdoms: a tame running lizard that pulls carts and carries adventurers. Roams the savannas; likes meat.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.nightmare.desc: A black steed with a burning mane. It is not born in the world: it rises from the ashes of defeated bosses for the worthy.
bestiary.isekai_mahou.aurora_stag.desc: A white stag with glowing antlers, raised in the royal gardens. The Kingdom only grants it to the Honored.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.title: Mounts and Vehicles
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.intro: Walking gets tiring, traveler. This world has mounts for those who earn their trust, and magic vehicles for those who can build.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.lore: Reins call a mount that is already tamed and saddled. The mount ability key (default R) only works while riding.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.outro: From the ground to the sky, the world just got smaller. Where to now?
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.ride.hint: The easy way: buy the Land Drake Reins at the Guild shop (rank E), use the item and click the mount with an empty hand. You can also tame a wild Land Drake (savannas and plains) with meat and add a Saddle (the Guild sells them). Any saddled animal counts, even a horse.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.ride.lore: Sneak to dismount. Sneak + click tells it to wait or follow. The Mount Whistle calls yours from afar.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.ability.hint: While riding, press the "Mount ability" key (default R). Each mount has its own: sprint, leap, dive...
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.ability.lore: The panel next to the hotbar shows the ability and its cooldown.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.vehicle.hint: Buy from the Mechanic (plaza of world cities or your city's Mechanic's Workshop): Boat, Cart, Carpet, Broom, Rover, Airship, Skiff and Galleon. Place it on the ground and click to board.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.vehicle.lore: It runs on the pilot's mana (25%% is always kept for fighting); with none to spare, it uses its Mana Crystal charge (click it with a crystal). Sneak + hit to pack it up.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.tame.hint: Griffin (mountains): raw fish or meat. Sky Ray (Elemental Plane): an Essence. Pegasus (Celestial Sanctuary): Golden Apples. Wyvern (Abyss): rotten flesh, then a Shadow Essence. Click a wild one with an empty hand to learn what it wants.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.tame.lore: After taming, add a Saddle. In the air: jump climbs, sneak descends.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.stag.hint: Reach Honored reputation with the Kingdom: the Reins are delivered on the spot.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.stag.lore: It leaps high and never takes fall damage: the mountain mount.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.nightmare.hi: Every boss you defeat has a chance to drop the Nightmare Reins. On the sixth boss they are guaranteed.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.nightmare.lo: Immune to fire, it shields its rider from flames and burns enemies with the Infernal Gallop.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.fleet.hint: Each vehicle is good for one terrain: try the sky, the water and the land.
journal.isekai_mahou.mounts.fleet.lore: "Those with a fleet have no borders."
